"District Policy Pathfinder aims to address these challenges. The data is structured to support cross-district comparisons and longitudinal analysis going back to 2014-15 on key metrics. The data is transparently coded and documented with a clear, consistent methodology, making it easier to verify. With new data released annually, the sample will continue to grow.


Researchers can download directly from the Explore the Data tool and export to CSV for use in Stata, R, Python, or other analytic tools. A full data dictionary details answer options and definitions for each metric. Datasets are designed to integrate with other sources, and even include NCES IDs, to extend your analysis."

Summary: Annual reports on teacher preparation programs: enrollment, completers, and licensure test pass rates, by state and program.

Name: U.S. COVID-19 County Policy Database
Description: The objective of the U.S. COVID-19 County Policy (UCCP) Database is to systematically gather, characterize, and assess variation in U.S. county-level COVID-19-related policies. (paper link: https://bmcpublichealth.biomedcentral.com/articles/10.1186/s12889-022-14132-6 )

Name: UNICEF Data
Description: "Monitoring the situation of children and women"
Summary: UNICEF data on the situation of children and women worldwide, by country and indicator.

Name: United States Census Bureau Data
Description: Explorer and table generator for US Census data.
Summary: The Census Bureau's tool for finding and downloading tables from the ACS, the decennial census, and other surveys.

Name: Urban Institute's Education Data Portal/Explorer
Description: School, district, and college-level data.
Summary: Cleaned, linked versions of CCD, CRDC, IPEDS, College Scorecard, and other federal education data, with an API and R and Stata packages.

Name: The Urban Institute's Education-to-Workforce Framework Data Tool
Description: "The Education-to-Workforce Indicator Framework makes it easy to track the outcomes and conditions most critical to students’ success. Through its 99 indicators, the framework empowers policymakers, administrators, educators, community organizations, researchers, parents, and students to work together to measure achievement and take action in their community. Here, we have collected all available national data, allowing you to compare indicators of success across geographies, over time, and much more to help answer essential questions about student achievement. To start, select a community on the right or use the button above to download all the data."
Summary: An Urban Institute tool with national, state, and local data on 99 indicators, from early childhood through the workforce.

Name: Utah State Board of Education Data & Statistics
Description: A variety of data about Utah public schools. See also: https://datagateway.schools.utah.gov/

Name: Vermont Agency of Education Data and Reporting
Description: "Each year, the Agency of Education collects school, educational, student, and financial data from Vermont's education community. The information collected helps inform agency staff, schools, educators, and taxpayers about the functionality and success of Vermont's education system. "

Name: Virginia Department of Education Data & Reports
Description: "The effective use of accurate and detailed information on student achievement and other school-quality factors is central to Virginia’s commitment to providing quality instruction for all students. VDOE uses information on achievement and school quality to shape policy decisions and help educators at all levels gather, analyze, and use data to improve teaching and learning – while protecting student privacy."
Summary: Virginia Department of Education data and reports on achievement, school quality, and other school indicators.

Name: Washington State Office of Superintendent of Public Instruction Data for Public Use Portal
Description: "The data on this portal does not fully represent all data publically available from OSPI, but is designed to be a hub for locating the majority of data available."

Name: What Works Clearinghouse Study Findings
Summary: Downloadable data on the education studies the What Works Clearinghouse has reviewed: designs, samples, outcomes, and effect sizes. Useful for meta-analysis.

Name: WHO Global Health Observatory data repository
Description: "WHO's gateway to health-related statistics for more than 1000 indicators for its 194 Member States. Data are organized to monitor progress towards the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), including health status indicators to monitor progress towards for the overall health goal, indicators to track equity in health indicators, and the indicators for the specific health and health-related targets of the SDGs."
Summary: World Health Organization data on more than 1,000 health indicators for its member states.

Name: Wisconsin Department of Public Instruction Data & Media
Description: See options under "Data Submission and Reporting"
Summary: Wisconsin Department of Public Instruction data pages, with downloadable files on enrollment, staff, and assessment.

Name: Wisconsin Department of Public Instruction Public Staff Reporting
Description: Public reports on staff in Wisconsin public schools, from the Department of Public Instruction.

Name: Wyoming School District Enrollment & Staffing Data
Description: "This publication provides data about school district staff, average salaries of staff by various classifications, and information on students related to enrollment by grade, gender and ethnicity. The information was compiled from local school district reports submitted each October to the Wyoming Department of Education."

Name: Youth Risk Behavior Surveillance System (YRBSS) (Centers for Disease Control & Prevention)
Description: "The Youth Risk Behavior Surveillance System (YRBSS) is a set of surveys that track behaviors that can lead to poor health in students grades 9 through 12."
